interpretations.click: Normal attack fires full caster damage plus a separate ramping drone hit. Persistent S2 funnel projectile locks its target and ignores operator range. Its inferred interval uses current owner BAT/ASPD; original _waitFirstPeriod=0 is preserved. Untargetable/hidden locked targets do not receive drone hits or accumulate missed periods; resume permits one hit followed by a full interval.
interpretations.indigo: Bind-excluding selector exists only with unlocked talent. Three stored attacks are consumed at release, each projectile applies talent separately. S1 negative final BAT scaler is interpreted as 1+bb (-.8=>.2); S2 positive value is a direct factor (.8=>.6). S2 aura polls .2s and waits damage interval before first tick.
interpretations.pudding: Normal chain count is promotion-aware trait max_target, radius1.7, falloff.85. S2 interprets max_target as bounce count (bounceTimesAsDamageTimes=0), includes initial hit and can revisit earlier enemies only after unused neighbors run out; perDamageInterval.15 and speeds10/6 retained.

unresolvedFidelity: Attack-event times are from pinned Spine clips; current adapters scale those windups by ASPD. Original client animation-speed caps and frame rounding are not emulated.
Indigo negative S1 BAT final-scaler blackboard conversion (1+-.8) is inferred from sign convention and skill text; numeric prefab enum alone does not specify conversion.
Click persistent S2 drone uses current owner interval; executable controller interval calculation was not extracted.

Pudding S2 bounceTimesAsDamageTimes=0 is interpreted as four bounces plus the initial hit. .85 per-bounce scale is retained from the prefab, but exact executable chain-lightning interactions need gameplay validation.
Click hidden/untargetable resume timing is capped to one pending hit without backlog; exact client controller polling phase was not extracted.
